public_rationale: Financial conditions and competition can be investigated, but this sentence adds two undefined judgments: that the pressures are huge and that OpenAI needs a win. Financing does not disprove those judgments, and spending or rivalry would not establish their asserted severity or necessity. Scoring the whole sentence would require supplying a material test Marcus did not provide.
limitations: This does not find that OpenAI faced no economic or competitive pressure.
Narrower claims about particular financial figures or competitive measurements could be assessed separately.
